errors.text: The proposed B2/L12 Ti-rich precipitates do not reconstruct the compositionally segregated C14 Laves phase central to the target.
Rapid quenching is assumed to suppress the secondary phase, whereas in the target it stabilizes the fcc+C14 dual-phase microstructure.
The mechanism is assigned primarily to strain-enhanced orbital moments, omitting the target's Ti-sublattice antiparallel coupling, spin-canted components, and C14-associated domain-wall pinning.
Treating incoherent-interface domain-wall pinning as a failure condition conflicts with the target mechanism, in which pinning contributes to the enhanced coercivity.
